conservative.read: This conservative plan aims for capital preservation with a realistic target of ~1.5% per month. It significantly de-risks the portfolio by cutting all leveraged ETFs and underperforming positions, reducing potential drawdowns and margin call risk.

balanced.read: This balanced plan focuses on risk-first growth, targeting ~2.5% per month. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while introducing a high-quality scanner setup, aiming for a blend of stability and growth with controlled risk.

aggressive.read: This aggressive growth plan targets ~4% per month by leaning into leveraged ETFs and high-scoring scanner setups. This approach significantly raises both potential upside and drawdown, and leveraged ETFs are subject to daily decay and rebalancing, requiring strict stop discipline to manage risk.
